## Findings
- claim-1: The 2024 paper defines bigrassmannians \(v_{r,s,t,n}\in S_n\) by \(1\le t\le r,s\le n\), \(t>r+s-n\), and defines \(J_v=\operatorname{Span}_{\mathbb Z}\{\sigma_u:u\ge v\}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 68-83]
- claim-2: Its coefficient ring is \(\Lambda=\Lambda(x_1,x_2,\ldots)\) over \(\mathbb Z\), with \(I_{r,n-r}=\operatorname{Span}_{\mathbb Z}\{s_\lambda:\lambda\nsubseteq(n-r)^r\}\), \(\overline\Lambda=\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\), and \(H^*(\mathrm{Gr}_{r,n})\cong\overline\Lambda\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 89-94]
- claim-3: Theorem 1.2 sets \(i=s-t+1\), \(j=r-t+1\), \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\), and proves that \(J_v\subset\overline\Lambda\) is minimally generated by \(\{\overline{s}_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 95-110]
- claim-4: The other 2011 family is \(\{\overline{s}_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\}\), but the 2024 text presents it only in Remark 4.7 and says its minimality “could” be proved by transposing the arguments; it is not included in the stated Theorem 1.2. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 503-512]
- claim-5: The 2011 stronger proposed statement is, for \(M=J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\) over integral symmetric functions, \(M/\Lambda_+M\cong\mathbb Z^{\binom{a+b}{a}}\); the authors explicitly state that proof had eluded them. [source-2@L1536-L1552|claim=formal-document]
- claim-6: The stronger statement is not merely minimality: it asserts torsion-freeness and the exact free-abelian structure of indecomposables. The 2024 theorem statement contains no assertion about \(J_v/\Lambda_+J_v\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 95-110]
## Strategy
The requested source-refresh certificate is established. The 2024 full text defines \(v,J_v\) [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 68-83], the integral ring and Grassmannian quotient [lines 89-94], and Theorem 1.2’s hypotheses, parameters, and minimal family [lines 95-110]. It proves minimality only for the tall family; the transposed family is only proposed in Remark 4.7 [lines 503-512]. The stronger 2011 integral statement \(J_v/\Lambda_+J_v\cong\mathbb Z^{\binom{a+b}{a}}\) remains unproved by these sources [source-2@L1536-L1552|claim=formal-document].

## Gaps
The stronger integral indecomposables statement is **not established**: Theorem 1.2 asserts irredundancy, not torsion-freeness or the stated free-abelian quotient.

## Next
No parent proof attempted. Any proof of integral indecomposables, or of minimality for the transposed family, requires separate work.
